name: hitl
description: Ask a human for decisions, approvals or information — durable requests into a user's h/ inbox, carried by a Job that completes with the answer. Load before anything that needs human sign-off or missing input.

content.inline:
## Human-in-the-Loop (HITL)
Ask a human via `hitl_request` `{title, description?, asks, user?, timeout?}` → returns a Job that stays open until answered. Poll the job by id; COMPLETE carries the response, FAILED means rejected or expired.

Ask types (each ask: `{id, type, prompt, required?, options?, grants?}`):
- `text` → free text answer (string)
- `approval` → yes/no (boolean). MAY carry `grants` issued only if approved.
- `choice` → pick ONE `options` entry (answer = option id)
- `checkboxes` → pick MANY (answer = array of option ids). Options MAY carry `grants` issued only if selected.

Rules:
- Ask sparingly; batch related questions into ONE request rather than interrupting repeatedly.
- Put the FULL decision context in `description` — the human sees only the record, never your conversation.
- Use the narrowest ask type that fits; `text` only when free text is genuinely needed.
- Set `timeout` (seconds) for time-sensitive asks and handle the FAILED outcome; never treat a rejection as an error to retry.
- Offer only the minimum `grants` (`{with, can, exp?}`), scoped as narrowly as possible.
- Omit `user` to ask your own owner; asking another user requires a `hitl/request` delegation from them.
- You CANNOT answer asks — `hitl_respond` is refused for agents, including asks sitting in your own owner's inbox. Answering issues capability grants under the inbox owner's authority, so only that human may do it. Ask, then wait: poll your job id.

Watching: `hitl_list` shows your owner's inbox and `covia_read path=h/<id>` the full ask, so you can see what is pending — but resolving it is the human's act, not yours.
